Utilisation is a key revenue driver; indicates solid activity but with room to tighten.
Long-duration, firm backlog improves revenue visibility and earnings stability.
Higher pricing should lift EBITDA margins amid a tight accommodation market.
Strong operational execution supports revenue capture and cost control.
Future 6-month firm work adds optionality, but no near-term revenue impact.

This is a mid-cycle confirmation of improving pricing and backlog as offshore accommodation tightens. A disclosed day rate/EBITDA uplift or additional multi-year awards would turn this into a larger catalyst.
